Mr. Eric Long Chen, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of ZKH, stated, "In the third quarter, we built on our first-half momentum, delivering our fastest year-over-year growth in GMV and revenue since our IPO. This growth was driven by new customer wins and a greater share of existing customers' spending, reflecting our continued market share gains in China's highly fragmented MRO market. Demand was especially robust in industries benefiting from China's manufacturing strength and the AI infrastructure build-out, such as nonferrous metals, semiconductors, machinery manufacturing, and utilities, where GMV grew by more than 40% year-over-year. At the customer level, GMV from SMEs on the ZKH platform maintained growth of approximately 30%, while growth among key accounts, including state-owned enterprises and leading private enterprises, accelerated to more than 20%.


We also made important progress on our AI strategy. We formally established our AI subsidiary, LingLong Intelligence, launched LingLong Insight 1.0, a lightweight on-the-edge industrial AI model that combines image and text understanding to support on-site material verification. This launch extends our offering into customers' on-site operations, creating opportunities to deepen customer relationships and cross-sell MRO solutions. With strong momentum heading into the fourth quarter, we are confident that we will deliver on the full-year growth and profitability targets we set at the start of the year. This will provide a strong foundation for our continued growth and scaled profitability in 2027."


Mr. Jerry Qian Wang, Chief Financial Officer of ZKH, added, "Building on our first-ever operating profit in the second quarter, we delivered further gains in profitability in the third quarter, driven by robust top-line growth and expanding operating leverage. GMV growth accelerated to 24.1% year-over-year, while gross margin on a GMV basis remained largely stable at 14.7%. We also maintained disciplined cost management while supporting continued business expansion. Operating expenses increased by 7.3% year-over-year, well below the pace of GMV growth, with operating expenses as a percentage of GMV declining to 13.9% from 16.1% in the same period of 2025. Together, these factors drove a significant improvement in our bottom line. Non-GAAP adjusted net profit turned positive from a year-ago loss and increased substantially on a sequential basis. For the first nine months of 2026, non-GAAP adjusted net profit exceeded RMB96 million. Our stronger earnings also helped drive meaningful year-over-year improvements in operating cash flow in the third quarter and the first nine months of 2026. Looking ahead, our sustained growth momentum and improving profitability position us well to achieve our full-year financial targets and have further strengthened our confidence in our financial outlook for 2027."


\[1\] GMV is the total transaction value of orders placed on the Company's platform and shipped to customers, excluding taxes, net of the returned amount.


\[2\] Customers are those that transacted with the Company during the reporting period, mainly comprised of enterprise customers in various industries.


\[3\] Non-GAAP EBITDA is defined as net profit/(loss) before interest expenses, income tax expenses/(benefits) and depreciation and amortization expenses.


\[4\] Non-GAAP adjusted net (loss)/profit is defined as net (loss)/profit excluding share-based compensation expenses.


**Third Quarter 2026 Business Highlights**


- **Business Momentum.**


- Year-over-year growth in both GMV and revenue accelerated further in the third quarter, the fastest pace since the Company's IPO.
- GMV from SME customers on the ZKH platform maintained approximately 30% year-over-year growth, supported by customer wins across a broader range of industries. Growth in GMV from key accounts accelerated to more than 20% year-over-year, driven by higher average GMV per customer as the Company captured a greater share of customers' procurement spending.


- **Product Capabilities.**


- Continued to broaden product offerings, with sellable SKUs exceeding 30 million as of quarter-end.
- Continued to strengthen capabilities in professional MRO categories, particularly electrical and automation products and industrial spare parts, with a focus on the semiconductor, communications and electronics, and new energy sectors.
- Private-label GMV grew by more than 30% year-over-year and accounted for approximately 10% of total GMV, contributing to gross margin improvement.


- **Fulfillment Network.**


- Launched an intelligent transportation dispatch system that optimizes order allocation and improves vehicle loading rates.
- Added a service center warehouse in Lanzhou, expanding network coverage and strengthening service capabilities in northwestern China.
- Reduced fulfillment expenses as a percentage of revenue by 51 basis points year-over-year.


- **AI Capabilities.**


- Advanced industrial AI capabilities and expanded commercialization.


- In September, LingLong Intelligence, the Company's AI subsidiary, launched LingLong Insight 1.0, a lightweight on-the-edge industrial multimodal AI model that enables on-site material identification and verification. The launch extends the Company's AI capabilities into customers' manufacturing workflows.
- Secured new customers in industries including automotive and electrical equipment manufacturing, while expanding relationships with existing customers to meet a broader range of their comprehensive needs. These engagements supported wider adoption of the Company's AI agents, including AI Materials Manager and Linglong Huisou, across materials data governance, intelligent procurement, and workflow coordination.


- Drove further efficiency gains through Company-wide AI adoption.


- Extended AI applications across the Company's workforce, generating productivity gains equivalent to an estimated 43,000 working hours during the quarter.
- Expanded the use of the Company's proprietary AI coding platform beyond R&D employees, enabling business teams to build and deploy their own workflow tools.


- **International Expansion.**


- International GMV exceeded RMB160 million for the first nine months of 2026, generated by serving Chinese manufacturers expanding overseas and through online sales in the United States.
- The Company continued to strengthen its product offerings and supply chain capabilities, with an increasing focus on profitability.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


***Net Revenues.*** Net revenues were RMB2,752.9 million (US$410.6 million), representing an increase of 18.2% from RMB2,328.4 million in the same period of 2025.

***Cost of Revenues.*** Cost of revenues was RMB2,274.4 million (US$339.2 million), representing an increase of 17.3% from RMB1,938.2 million in the same period of 2025.


***Gross Profit and Gross Margin.*** Gross profit was RMB478.5 million (US$71.4 million), representing an increase of 22.6% from RMB390.2 million in the same period of 2025. Gross margin was 17.4%, compared with 16.8% in the same period of 2025.


***Operating Expenses.*** Operating expenses were RMB453.4 million (US$67.6 million), up 7.3% from RMB422.5 million in the same period of 2025. Operating expenses were 16.5% of net revenues, compared with 18.1% in the same period of 2025.


- ***Fulfillment Expenses.*** Fulfillment expenses were RMB92.9 million (US$13.8 million), up 2.7% from RMB90.4 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to higher distribution expenses, partially offset by lower rental and property management fees. Fulfillment expenses were 3.4% of net revenues, compared with 3.9% in the same period of 2025.
- ***Sales and Marketing Expenses.*** Sales and marketing expenses were RMB159.4 million (US$23.8 million), up 9.2% from RMB145.9 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to higher employee benefits expenses and service fees. Sales and marketing expenses were 5.8% of net revenues, compared with 6.3% in the same period of 2025.
- ***Research and Development Expenses.*** Research and development expenses were RMB40.8 million (US$6.1 million), up 1.2% from RMB40.3 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to higher service fees, partially offset by lower employee benefits expenses. Research and development expenses were 1.5% of net revenues, compared with 1.7% in the same period of 2025.
- ***General and Administrative Expenses.*** General and administrative expenses were RMB160.3 million (US$23.9 million), up 9.9% from RMB145.8 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to higher service fees and employee benefits expenses, partially offset by lower credit losses. General and administrative expenses were 5.8% of net revenues, compared with 6.3% in the same period of 2025.


***Income/(Loss) from Operations.*** Income from operations was RMB25.1 million (US$3.7 million), compared with loss from operations of RMB32.3 million in the same period of 2025. Operating income margin was 0.9%, compared with operating loss margin of 1.4% in the same period of 2025.


***Non-GAAP EBITDA.*** Non-GAAP EBITDA was RMB55.4 million (US$8.3 million), compared with negative RMB8.5 million in the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP EBITDA margin was 2.0%, compared with negative 0.4% in the same period of 2025.


***Net Profit/(Loss).*** Net profit was RMB42.4 million (US$6.3 million), compared with net loss of RMB24.3 million in the same period of 2025. Net profit margin was 1.5%, compared with net loss margin of 1.0% in the same period of 2025.


***Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Profit/(Loss).*** Non-GAAP adjusted net profit was RMB56.5 million (US$8.4 million), compared with non-GAAP adjusted net loss of RMB14.1 million in the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP adjusted net profit margin was 2.1%, compared with non-GAAP adjusted net loss margin of 0.6% in the same period of 2025.


***Basic and Diluted Net Profit/(Loss) per ADS **\[5\]** and Non-GAAP Adjusted Basic and Diluted Net Profit/(Loss) per ADS **\[6\]** .*** Basic and diluted net profit per ADS was RMB0.26 (US$0.04), compared with basic and diluted net loss per ADS of RMB0.15 in the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP adjusted basic and diluted net profit per ADS were RMB0.35 (US$0.05), compared with non-GAAP adjusted basic and diluted net loss per ADS of RMB0.09 in the same period of 2025.


**Balance Sheet and Cash Flow**


As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents, restricted cash, and short-term investments of RMB1.70 billion (US$252.9 million), compared with RMB1.92 billion as of December 31, 2025.


Net cash generated from operating activities was RMB124.5 million (US$18.6 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB105.5 million in the same period of 2025.


**Share Repurchase Update**


On June 13, 2025, the board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to US$50 million for a 12-month period ending on June 13, 2026. On June 15, 2026, the Company announced that the board had authorized an extension of the new program for an additional 12 months through June 13, 2027, with all other terms and conditions remaining unchanged. As of September 30, 2026, the Company repurchased an aggregate of approximately 3.14 million ADSs for approximately US$9.54 million from the open market.

\[6\] Non-GAAP adjusted basic and diluted net profit/(loss) per ADS is a non-GAAP financial measure, which is calculated by dividing non-GAAP adjusted net profit/(loss) attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders by the weighted average number of ADSs.

**About ZKH Group Limited**


ZKH Group Limited (NYSE:ZKH ) is a leading MRO procurement service platform in China, underpinned by robust supply chain capabilities and dedicated to serving customers globally through a product-led, agentic AI-driven approach. Through its primary online platforms, the *ZKH platform* , the *GBB platform* and the *Northsky platform* , along with innovative technology and extensive industry expertise, the Company provides bespoke MRO procurement solutions to a diverse and loyal customer base. These solutions encompass hyper-personalized product curation from a comprehensive selection of quality products at competitive prices. Additionally, the Company ensures timely and reliable product delivery through professional fulfillment services. By focusing on reducing procurement costs and addressing management efficiency challenges, ZKH is transforming the opaque MRO procurement process and empowering all stakeholders across the value chain.


For more information, please visit:[https://ir.zkh.com](https://ir.zkh.com/) .


**Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


This press release contains the following non-GAAP financial measures: non-GAAP adjusted net (loss)/profit, non-GAAP adjusted net (loss)/profit per ADS, basic and diluted, and non-GAAP EBITDA. The non-GAAP financial measures should not be considered in isolation from or construed as alternatives to their most directly comparable financial measures prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America. Investors are encouraged to review the historical non-GAAP financial measures in reconciliation to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures.


The Company defines non-GAAP adjusted net (loss)/profit for a specific period as net loss in the same period excluding share-based compensation expenses. The Company defines non-GAAP EBITDA as net loss before interest expenses, income tax expenses/(benefits) and depreciation and amortization expenses. Non-GAAP adjusted net (loss)/profit per ADS is calculated by dividing adjusted net (loss)/profit attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders by the weighted average number of ordinary shares during the periods and then multiplied by 35.


The Company presents these non-GAAP financial measures because they are used by the management to evaluate the Company's operating performance and formulate business plans. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures help identify underlying trends in its business that could otherwise be distorted by the effect of certain expenses that are included in net loss and certain expenses that are not expected to result in future cash payments or that are non-recurring in nature. The Company also believes that the use of these non-GAAP financial measures facilitates investors' assessment of its operating performance, enhances the overall understanding of its past performance and future prospects and allows for greater visibility with respect to key metrics used by the management in financial and operational decision making.


The non-GAAP financial measures have material limitations as analytical metrics and may not be calculated in the same manner by all companies. The Company's non-GAAP financial measures do not include all income and expense items that affect the Company's operations. They may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures used by other companies. In light of the foregoing limitations, you should not consider the non-GAAP financial measures as substitutes for, or superior to, their most directly comparable financial measures prepared in accordance with GAAP. The Company encourages investors and others to review its financial information in its entirety and not rely on a single financial measure.


For more information on these non-GAAP financial measures, please see the table captioned "Reconciliations of Non-GAAP Results" set forth at the end of this press release.
